title: Kind Thoughts for a Busy Day
intro: A few small, kind thoughts. Read one, or read them all, and carry on whenever you like.

cards.back: Taking a minute is not falling behind. It is part of how a day gets done.
Not everything needs to be perfect today. Some things only need to work.

cards.front: You have done hard things before
cards.back: Think of one problem from this month that now feels small.
A single tidy function or a single sent message is real progress.
Asking for help early often saves a lot of time, and most people are glad to give it.
While something runs, you do not have to fill the time. Looking out of the window is fine.

cards.front: Be as patient as you would be with a friend
cards.back: If a friend were stuck on this, you would be kind. You can be kind to yourself too.

cards.front: Notice one thing that went well
cards.back: It can be tiny: a clean build, a good cup of tea, a quiet five minutes.
Think of a person who made your week easier. A short thank you can mean a lot.
If the morning went sideways, the afternoon is still yours to shape.
